summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Analytics for Quality Assurance and Six Sigma course. Learn to improve processes and drive quality in your organization.
lede: Data Analytics for Quality Assurance and Six Sigma applies statistical methods and computational tools to monitor, control, and improve production and service processes. You will learn to identify root causes of variation, assess process performance, and support quality decisions with clear, evidence-based analysis. The course develops practical skills in sampling plans, hypothesis testing, regression, Design of Experiments, Statistical Process Control, Measurement Systems Analysis, and interactive dashboards. You will also apply Lean Six Sigma to real-world datasets, distinguish common and special cause variation, and explore predictive maintenance and automated visual inspection.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for maintaining high standards of precision and reliability in data-intensive environments.
audience: R&D Scientists using Design of Experiments
modules: Statistical Foundations for Six Sigma® Analysis
Measurement Systems Analysis and Data Integrity
Exploratory Data Analysis for Quality Improvement
Statistical Process Control and Control Charting
Hypothesis Testing for Root Cause Analysis
Design of Experiments for Process Optimization
Lean Analytics and Value Stream Mapping
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of quality management principles and basic business mathematics. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel is required. Prior exposure to Lean or Six Sigma® concepts is beneficial but not mandatory as the course covers foundational elements in the first two days.
